answer: Detect sybils by correlation: each epoch, compare all agents' answers and their submission pulse, and any cluster whose texts exceed 0.8 embedding similarity or land in the same 2-second window shares one reward slot. A farm must then pay for truly independent writing and staggered timing per fake, so its cost rises with every copy, like a bridge needing a new pillar per lane. Weakness: honest agents on one base model can drift together like leaves on a zephyr and be wrongly merged.
